options.name: write_pcurves
options.doc: write parametric curves to the STEP file. Defaults to True.

options.name: precision_mode
options.doc: geometric data precision. Defaults to PrecisionMode.AVERAGE.

options.name: tolerance
options.doc: A linear deflection setting which limits the distance between a curve and its tessellation. Setting this value too low will result in large meshes that can consume computing resources. Setting the value too high can result in meshes with a level of detail that is too low. The default is a good starting point for a range of cases. Defaults to 1e-3.

options.name: angular_tolerance
options.doc: Angular deflection setting which limits the angle between subsequent segments in a polyline. Defaults to 0.1.

options.name: ascii_format
options.doc: Export the file as ASCII (True) or binary (False) STL format. Defaults to False (binary).

options.name: include_uvs
options.doc: Include UV texture coordinates. Defaults to True.

options.name: atlas_packing
options.doc: Pack per-face UVs into a single atlas. Only used when *include_uvs* is True. Defaults to True.

options.name: atlas_gutter
options.doc: Normalized empty margin around each UV island in a packed atlas. Only used when *atlas_packing* is True. Defaults to 0.0.

options.name: linear_deflection
options.doc: A linear deflection setting which limits the distance between a curve and its tessellation. Setting this value too low will result in large meshes that can consume computing resources. Setting the value too high can result in meshes with a level of detail that is too low. The default is a good starting point for a range of cases. Defaults to 1e-3.

options.name: angular_deflection
options.doc: Angular deflection setting which limits the angle between subsequent segments in a polyline. Defaults to 0.1.
